statement: You are given a string s of length n. Its Z array z has one entry per index.

For each index i from 1 to n − 1, z[i] is the length of the longest substring starting at i that is also a prefix of s; that is, the largest k with s[0 … k − 1] equal to s[i … i + k − 1]. By convention z[0] = 0.
Compute the Z array in O(n) time, by keeping the rightmost window [l, r) already known to match a prefix and reusing its values instead of comparing from scratch. Return the array z.

examples.explanation: At index 9 the text "aabxaabxa…" matches the first 8 characters "aabxaabx"; the next pair, "a" against "c", differs, so z[9] = 8. At index 4, "aabx" matches and then "c" differs from "a", so z[4] = 4.
In a string of one repeated letter, the suffix starting at i matches the prefix all the way to the end, so z[i] = n − i.
